anti_overlap: Owns the MECHANISM — accumulation, gating symmetry, transmission, threshold release, warning states, and rate-regulation placement; the renga lens owns the resulting SEQUENCE — variety, recurrence spacing, tier ratio, obligated placement — and does not perform arithmetic on drives or curves.

Owns the numeric reconciliation of GATE 2 and the re-derivation of the design-2026-07-24 condition table; the renga lens may argue that the double path collapses the year's topic variety but must not attempt the trajectory arithmetic.

Owns the death and refusal predicates as release mechanisms (window shape, dose versus coincidence, hysteresis, pre-release warning); the renga lens owns whether the resulting events are spaced and distinguishable once they do fire.

Reasons in barrels, trains, gates, torque, escapement release, warning runs, stop-work, maintaining power, and rate regulation; the renga lens reasons in verses, links, shifts, topics, seats, and aversions — no shared primitive vocabulary.
decision_lens: Would a clockmaker sign off that this movement expresses its state — or condemn a barrel that is continuously rewound so the dial never moves (health pinned at 9810), an unlocking window of measure zero that the train can never pass through (exact-zero for 40 ticks), a strike with no warning run (death or refusal arriving from nowhere), a complication installed but unable to engage (the refusal conjunction), two barrels loaded onto one train with no reconciliation (GATE 2), or a rate that lives entirely on the dial rather than in the movement (all tuning in raven-vocab)? Rank by whether the flaw makes the mechanism structurally incapable of expressing danger (P0), guarantees mis-timed or unreachable release (P1), degrades regulation (P2), or is finishing (P3).
distance_rationale: Clockmaking is a centuries-refined manual craft about stored power, governed transmission and timed release; it has no causal relation to a Rust needs substrate, yet it is the discipline that already solved every question this goal opens. A reservoir that is continuously refilled cannot express state (health pinned at 9810 by ungated recovery); a secondary reservoir rewound on its own schedule exists specifically to STOP upstream variation being felt (the exact risk of routing all deprivation through health); a release condition of measure zero means the train never unlocks (death at exactly zero for 40 ticks); the warning run is the craft's name for the gradient the goal's OUTCOME clause demands; two barrels on one train is the double-count of GATE 2; and 'the rate must not live on the dial' is the sharpest possible framing of R12's substrate/vocabulary split. It is not on the banned list and shares no parent discipline with Japanese linked verse.
expected_isomorphisms: health with ungated recovery and night-gated loss <-> a going barrel under continuous rewind with stop-work: the movement never sees its own limits and the dial never moves

routing all deprivation through a single health accumulator <-> inserting a remontoire, whose entire designed purpose is to isolate the downstream from upstream variation — the architecture the goal proposes is the architecture the craft uses to DAMP a signal

death requiring exactly zero for 40 consecutive ticks <-> a mis-set escapement unlocking window of measure zero: a release the train can never pass through, versus the craft alternative of an accumulated-dose release with hysteresis

no gradient into death, and the demand to 'see it coming and act in time' <-> the WARNING run a striking clock makes before the hammer falls; a strike without warning is a fault, not a difficulty setting

the refusal predicate as a conjunction of a common and a near-impossible term <-> rack-and-snail strike work fully installed whose gathering pallet can never engage: a complication that exists in the movement and never fires

deficits pulling condition directly AND via health (GATE 2) <-> two barrels driving one train with no reconciliation, which is not automatically wrong but destroys the verified rate table unless one path is made the compensating one

all rates and thresholds owned by raven-vocab while animal-sim owns the mechanism <-> a movement whose rate depends on what is painted on the dial: the substrate can assert no survivability invariant for any vocabulary, which is how a year with zero deaths shipped unnoticed
focus: Whether making health the single accumulator every hardship routes through will TRANSMIT deprivation or SMOOTH it away, given that its recovery is ungated and its loss is night-gated; plus the release mechanics of death (exact-zero for 40 consecutive ticks, no warning run), the reconciliation of two drive paths onto one condition output (GATE 2), and whether any survivability invariant can live in a substrate whose numbers all belong to the vocabulary crate.
name: fd-horology-accumulator-and-release
persona: Apply the perspective of a pre-industrial clockmaker reasoning about going trains and strike work — the craft of getting stored power through a mechanism at a governed rate and releasing it at the right instant. This craft reasons about: where energy is ACCUMULATED (mainspring, weight, going barrel) versus where it is EXPRESSED (the escapement, the dial, the hammer); stop-work, which deliberately prevents a spring from ever reaching its extremes so the movement never sees its own limits; the fusee and the remontoire, two devices whose entire purpose is to ISOLATE the escapement from upstream variation — a remontoire being a secondary accumulator rewound on its own schedule so that whatever happens upstream stops being felt downstream; maintaining power, which keeps the train running while the only human input (winding) is applied; the difference between a rate fault and a release fault; escapement unlocking windows that must be neither too narrow to engage nor too wide to hold; the WARNING — the audible run-up a striking clock makes seconds before the hammer falls, without which a strike arrives from nowhere; rack-and-snail strike work that is fully installed yet cannot engage; and the discipline that the movement's rate must not depend on what is painted on the dial. It judges a mechanism by asking what actually moves, what is pinned, what cannot fire, and what fires with no notice.
review_areas: Accumulator or isolator: health with ungated recovery and night-gated loss is functionally a remontoire — a reservoir rewound on its own schedule, whose defining property is that upstream variation stops being felt downstream. Judge whether routing food and water deprivation THROUGH it makes the year sharper or strictly flatter than routing them directly, and specify exactly what gating discipline (loss/gain symmetry, recovery preconditions, a ceiling that is not free to return to) an accumulator needs before it can transmit rather than smooth. This is the goal's central architectural claim and the place to be most adversarial.

Two drives on one output (GATE 2): deficits pull condition directly AND will pull it via health. Treat this as two barrels on one train and demand the reconciliation — at what deficit values do the paths sum, where do they double-count the same physical fact, and which path should be the compensating one. Note that design-2026-07-24 verified a condition trajectory table and a 13000 all-empty sum against the SINGLE-path model; state whether the goal silently invalidates that table and what must be re-derived before any code lands.

Release mechanics (GATE 1 and cause b): a lethal need at EXACTLY zero for 40 consecutive ticks is an unlocking window a well-behaved train may never enter, and the craft alternatives are specific — accumulated dose (time-integral below a threshold) rather than instantaneous coincidence, hysteresis so a release once armed cannot be trivially disarmed, and a WARNING run emitted before the release so the event does not arrive from nowhere. Assess whether the goal's OUTCOME ('I can see it coming and act in time') is reachable by ANY tuning of the current predicate, or whether it requires a warning stage as a first-class emitted state.

Gating symmetry audit across all four needs: enumerate per need whether loss is gated (night, activity, season) and whether gain is gated (site availability, assignment, cost), and flag every need whose restore path can outrun its drain unconditionally. Health at 9810 is presented as a bug about health; test whether it is actually a substrate-wide asymmetry that will recur in the next need and in any future vocabulary.

Where the regulator lives (R12): if every rate, threshold and curve is vocabulary data, animal-sim can assert no survivability property at all — it cannot guarantee that an octopus game can lose an octopus. Judge whether the substrate needs an invariant layer (a self-check that a configured vocabulary is capable of producing loss, a validator over drain-versus-restore ratios, a rate-regulation contract) and whether that belongs in code, in check-agnosticism.sh, or in a test harness — and whether its absence is why a whole year could ship with zero deaths unnoticed.

The single input and whether it reaches the train: dispatch is the only winding action, and a refusing bird refuses every ground alike, so the input cannot engage the mechanism precisely when the mechanism is in the state the design most wants the player to answer. Examine what the horological answer (maintaining power — the mechanism must remain drivable while the human input is being applied) implies: whether refusal should be ground-specific, cost-specific, or answerable by a different verb, and whether the absence of any second verb is a deeper fault than the danger model.
severity_examples: P0: with recovery ungated and loss night-gated, health is a remontoire, not a load path — routing food and water deprivation through it will damp the one signal currently under real pressure (water floors at 1837 and sits under 7000 for 59% of the year) and produce a year that is FLATTER than today's, while appearing to add danger. Health at 9810 is not a calibration value to nudge; it is the arithmetic consequence of an asymmetric gate, and unless the gating is inverted in the same change, GATE 1's 'health becomes the sole death path' converts the game's only real pressure into a value that never moves.

P1: the goal proposes a second drive path onto condition while design-2026-07-24-needs-availability-and-condition.md's verified trajectory table (condition 10000 down to 7000 across food 10000 to 0; a 13000 sum at all-four-empty said to floor any bird) was derived under the single-path model. Landing GATE 2 without re-deriving that table means the documented spiral numbers, the refusal threshold, and the dodge margin are all quietly wrong at the extremes, and the first playtest will read as arbitrary rather than as the intended vise.

P1: death requiring a lethal need at exactly zero for 40 consecutive ticks is an unlocking window of measure zero with no warning run — a strike train that both cannot engage and, if it ever did, would fire with no notice. Both halves must change together: a dose-integral release gives the gradient, and a separately emitted warning state gives the notice the goal's OUTCOME clause depends on; fixing only the threshold produces deaths the player could not have seen coming, which is the opposite of what was asked for.
source_domain: Pre-industrial mechanical horology — going-train and strike work: mainspring and going barrel versus fusee, stop-work, the remontoire as a deliberate isolator, maintaining power, escapement unlocking windows, the warning run that precedes a strike, rack-and-snail strike work that can be installed yet unable to engage, and rate regulation that must not depend on the dial.
success_hints: Read crates/animal-sim/src/needs.rs, world.rs and sim.rs and build a per-need table: drain rate, drain gate, restore rate, restore gate, cap, and whether anything prevents a return to the ceiling; the load-bearing artifact for this review is that table plus which rows are asymmetric.

Run crates/ravenous-session/src/bin/how_close_is_it.rs and heal_gate.rs and water_budget.rs; report per-need floor, time-below-threshold, and specifically how many ticks health spent losing versus gaining — an accumulator that gains on most ticks cannot carry a spiral.

Re-derive the condition trajectory table from docs/design-2026-07-24-needs-availability-and-condition.md under the proposed double path by hand for at least three rows (food 4000, 2000, 0 with health degraded correspondingly) and state whether the table survives, needs damping, or needs the paths assigned to different outputs the way disposition/condition were split once already.

Trace the death predicate and the refusal predicate in code, then state for each whether it is an instantaneous-coincidence release or a dose release, and whether any pre-release state is emitted as an event the surface could show; if no warning state exists, say so plainly, because the goal's OUTCOME cannot be met without one.

Read scripts/check-agnosticism.sh and crates/raven-vocab/src/lib.rs to establish which numbers the substrate is forbidden to own, then answer concretely: what invariant could animal-sim assert that would have failed on the shipped year, and where would it live without breaking R12.

Check whether any verb other than dispatch exists in crates/animal-sim/src/command.rs and dispatch.rs; if not, evaluate the refusal design against the fact that the only input cannot engage a refusing animal, and propose the minimum mechanism change (ground-specific refusal, a cost the player can pay, an assignment that is not a dispatch) rather than a threshold tweak.
